subject: general
question: In 1977, the Government of Bengal erected its first statue dedicated to a female freedom fighter in Kolkata Maidan. What was her name?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Matangini Hazra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Matangini Hazra was not forgotten by the country for whose freedom she devoted her entire life.
 
• **In 1977, the first statue in the Kolkata Maidan dedicated to a woman revolutionary was that of Matangini Hazra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Matangini Hazra (1869-1942):**

 
 
• She was an Indian revolutionary who participated in the Indian independence movement until she was shot dead by the British Indian police in front of the Tamluk Police Station on September 29, 1942.
 
• She was affectionately known as Gandhi Buri, Bangla for old lady Gandhi.
 
• In 1905, she became actively interested in the Indian independence movement as a Gandhian.
 
• In 1932, she took part in the Non-cooperation Movement and was arrested for breaking the Salt Act.
